title: Verify settlements do not reference inactive/non-existent merchants
sqlValidation:
SELECT s.*, m.status
FROM dbo.Settlements s
JOIN dbo.Merchants m ON m.id = s.merchantId
WHERE m.status <> 'active';
sqlExpectedResult: 0 rows are returned for settlements that are required to belong only to active merchants.
